summary: Eldorado Gold Corporation filed a Form 6-K with a Material Change Report announcing completion of a board leadership transition. Effective July 30, 2026, Steven Reid stepped down as Chair and from the Board; Dan Myerson was appointed Chair and Patrick Godin Lead Independent Director. CEO George Burns will retire effective September 30, 2026, with Christian Milau assuming President and CEO. Additional executive changes include EVP transitions and departures. The filing is a routine disclosure of management succession and organizational changes, not a special situation.
